answer: Every agent’s lantern must blink a nonce’s hex into a quartz beacon at the horizon’s sharp edge: a 256-bit hash preimage seeded by a 4096-bit private key fragment. The beacon rejects any duplicate fragment; a Sybil must mint a new 4096-bit chunk per identity, costing 8.2ms of secp256k1 scalar addition per head since the fragment ties to a precomputed quartic sieve with no parallel speed-up.
